**Subject: Request for Work-From-Home Arrangement and Updated Offer Letter**

Dear [Manager's/HR's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am thrilled to be joining [Company Name] as [Your Designation] and am very much looking forward to contributing to the team.

I wanted to reach out regarding my work arrangement. After carefully reviewing my commute, I have found that the distance between my residence and the office is quite significant, making daily in-person attendance challenging and unsustainable in the long run. In light of this, I would like to formally request a work-from-home arrangement, either full-time or on a hybrid basis, whichever aligns best with the team's needs and company policy.

I am fully committed to maintaining productivity, meeting all deliverables, and staying closely connected with the team regardless of my work location. I am confident that a remote or hybrid arrangement will allow me to perform at my best while addressing the logistical constraints of my commute.

Additionally, if this arrangement is approved, I kindly request that the offer letter be updated to reflect the revised work-from-home terms along with an updated date of issuance, so that our agreement is formally documented.

I am happy to discuss this further at your convenience and am open to any conditions or expectations you may have regarding this arrangement.

Thank you for considering my request. I look forward to your response.

Warm regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Contact Number]
[Your Email Address]
